title: Madhya-khanda, part 6 (portion 29)
html:
The section "Meeting with Advaita and Haridasa": the Lord weeps after seeing Krishna in a dream; Nityananda beholds the Lord's forms; Nityananda at Advaita's; Advaita worships the Lord in Srivasa's house; the arrival of Haridasa; Nityananda's kaupina; the Lord vanishes with Srivasa and returns; the greatness of prema

Meeting with Advaita and Haridasa

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. One night, in the third watch, Sriman Mahaprabhu suddenly began to weep; Shachi-devi in alarm asked the reason for His weeping, and Mahaprabhu told His mother how He had seen Krishna in a dream. Sriman Nityananda Prabhu [beheld] the six-armed and other forms of Mahaprabhu; then at Mahaprabhu's command the devotees took Him to Advaita's [house], and there They spent two days in great bliss. [When] Murari [told the Lord] of Nityananda Prabhu's manifestations of prema, [the Lord laughed]. When Advaita [Prabhu], seeing Sriman Mahaprabhu in the house of Srivasa Pandita, worshipped Him, the Vaishnavas [danced in bliss]. [Thakura] Haridasa came [and met the Lord]. When Nityananda Prabhu [was taking leave] of Sriman Mahaprabhu, Mahaprabhu took Nityananda's kaupina [and distributed it] to the devotees, [and they tied it] on their heads. [When the Lord disappeared,] the devotees lamented, and when He returned, they were seized with boundless bliss.1

Raga turi; refrain: "Gora has remembered the past — that is why Gora weeps!"2

আর অপরূপ কথা কহিব এখন ।
না দেখিল না শুনিল গোরা-আচরণ ॥ ১ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā kahiba ekhana |
nā dekhila nā śunila gorā-ācaraṇa || 1 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now; na dekhila na shunila — such as none has seen or heard; gora-acharana — Gora's conduct

1Now I shall tell another wondrous story —
of such deeds of Gora as none has seen or heard.

সকল লোকের নাথ ক্ষিতি-অবতার ।
ভাগ্য করি' না মানহ ইহা আপনার ॥ ২ ॥

sakala lokera nātha kṣiti-abatāra |
bhāgya kari' nā mānaha ihā āpanāra || 2 ||

sakala lokera natha — the Lord of all worlds; kshiti-avatara — has descended on earth; bhagya kari — as good fortune; na manaha — you do not regard; iha apanara — this as your own

2The Lord of all worlds has descended on earth —
why do you not count this your good fortune?

চাতুরী না ঘুচে ছার পাষণ্ডি-হিয়ায় ।
জড়িত অন্তর তার এ বিষ্ণুমায়ায় ॥ ৩ ॥

cāturī nā ghuce chāra pāṣaṇḍi-hiẏāẏa |
jaṛita antara tāra e biṣṇumāẏāẏa || 3 ||

chaturi na ghuche — cunning does not leave; chhara pashandi-hiyaya — the vile hearts of the godless; jadita antara tara — their hearts are entangled; e vishnu-mayaya — in this maya of Vishnu

3Cunning does not leave the vile hearts of the godless:
their hearts are entangled in this maya of Vishnu.3

নির্মল হইবে যবে শুনে গোরাগুণ ।
ভবব্যাধি নাশিবারে এই সে কারণ ॥ ৪ ॥

nirmala haibe yabe śune gorāguṇa |
bhababyādhi nāśibāre ei se kāraṇa || 4 ||

nirmala haibe — they will become pure; yabe shune gora-guna — when they hear of Gora's qualities; bhava-vyadhi nashibare — to destroy the disease of worldly existence; ei se karana — this is the means

4They will become pure when they hear of Gora's qualities:
this is the means that cures the disease of worldly existence.

একদিন রাত্রি যায় তৃতীয় প্রহর ।
আচম্বিতে রোদন করয়ে বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৫ ॥

ekadina rātri yāẏa tṛtīẏa prahara |
ācambite rodana karaẏe biśbambhara || 5 ||

ekadina — one day; ratri yaya tritiya prahara — the third watch of the night was passing; achambite — suddenly; rodana karaye vishvambhara — Vishvambhara weeps

5One day, as the third watch of the night was passing,
Vishvambhara suddenly began to weep.

বিস্মিত হইয়া শচী পুছেন পুত্রেরে ।
কি কারণে কান্দ বাপ কহ না আমারে ॥ ৬ ॥

bismita haiẏā śacī puchena putrere |
ki kāraṇe kānda bāpa kaha nā āmāre || 6 ||

vismita haiya — astonished; shachi puchhena putrere — Shachi asks her son; ki karane kanda bapa — why do you weep, child; kaha na amare — do tell me

6Astonished, Shachi asks her son:
"Why are you weeping, child? Tell me.

তোমার কান্দনা শুনি' পোড়য়ে শরীর ।
ধরিতে না পারি হিয়া বুকে বাজে তীর ॥ ৭ ॥

tomāra kāndanā śuni' poṛaẏe śarīra |
dharite nā pāri hiẏā buke bāje tīra || 7 ||

tomara kandana shuni — hearing your weeping; podaye sharira — my body burns; dharite na pari hiya — I cannot hold my heart; buke baje tira — an arrow strikes my breast

7Hearing your weeping, I burn all over;
I cannot hold my heart — an arrow pierces my breast."

শুনিঞা মায়ের বাণী নিঃশব্দে রহে ।
শয্যায় বসিয়া যে দেখিল স্বপ্ন কহে ॥ ৮ ॥

śuniñā māẏera bāṇī niḥśabde rahe |
śayyāẏa basiẏā ye dekhila sbapna kahe || 8 ||

shuninya mayera vani — hearing his mother's words; nihshabde rahe — He remains silent; shayyaya basiya — sitting on the bed; ye dekhila svapna kahe — He tells the dream He saw

8Hearing His mother's words, He is silent,
and then, sitting up on the bed, tells the dream He saw:

নবীন নীরদ-কান্তি দেখিলুঁ পুরুষে ।
ময়ূরপাখার চূড়া অদ্ভুত ময়ূখে ॥ ৯ ॥

nabīna nīrada-kānti dekhiluṁ puruṣe |
maẏūrapākhāra cūṛā adbhuta maẏūkhe || 9 ||

navina nirada-kanti — with the lustre of a fresh raincloud; dekhilun purushe — I saw a Person; mayura-pakhara chuda — a crest of peacock feathers; adbhuta mayukhe — of wondrous radiance

9"I saw a Person shining like a fresh raincloud,
with a crest of peacock feathers, wondrously radiant;

কঙ্কণ কেয়ূর হার চরণে নূপুর ।
ললাটে চন্দন-চাঁদ কিরণ প্রচুর ॥ ১০ ॥

kaṅkaṇa keẏūra hāra caraṇe nūpura |
lalāṭe candana-cāṁda kiraṇa pracura || 10 ||

kankana keyura hara — bracelets, armlets, necklace; charane nupura — anklets on His feet; lalate chandana-chanda — a moon of sandal on His forehead; kirana prachura — richly shining

10bracelets, armlets, a necklace, bells on His feet,
on His forehead a moon of sandal, richly shining;

পীতবস্ত্র-পরিধান বংশী বামকরে ।
দেখিলুঁ সুন্দর এক হরিষ-অন্তরে ॥ ১১ ॥

pītabastra-paridhāna baṃśī bāmakare |
dekhiluṁ sundara eka hariṣa-antare || 11 ||

pita-vastra-paridhana — clad in yellow; bamshi vama-kare — a flute in His left hand; dekhilun sundara eka — I saw a Beautiful One; harisha-antare — with a joyful heart

11clad in yellow, with a flute in His left hand —
such a Beautiful One I saw, and My heart rejoiced."

রোদন করয়ে আঁখি গলে অশ্রুধার ।
না কহিও কেহো যেন না শুনয়ে আর ॥ ১২ ॥

rodana karaẏe āṁkhi gale aśrudhāra |
nā kahio keho yena nā śunaẏe āra || 12 ||

rodana karaye — He weeps; ankhi gale ashru-dhara — streams of tears flow from His eyes; na kahio — do not tell; keho yena na shunaye ara — let no one else hear

12He weeps, streams of tears flow from His eyes:
"Do not tell anyone, so that no one else may hear."

ঐছন বচন শুনি' শচী আনন্দিতা ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখোদিত অমৃতের কথা ॥ ১৩ ॥

aichana bacana śuni' śacī ānanditā |
biśbambhara-mukhodita amṛtera kathā || 13 ||

aichhana bachana shuni — hearing such words; shachi anandita — Shachi rejoiced; vishvambhara-mukhodita — risen from Vishvambhara's lips; amritera katha — nectarean words

13Hearing such words, the nectarean speech
risen from Vishvambhara's lips, Shachi rejoiced.

বিশ্বম্ভর পুলকে পূরিত সব দেহ ।
ঝলমল করে অঙ্গ-ছটায় সব গেহ ॥ ১৪ ॥

biśbambhara pulake pūrita saba deha |
jhalamala kare aṅga-chaṭāẏa saba geha || 14 ||

vishvambhara — Vishvambhara's; pulake purita saba deha — whole body is filled with thrills; jhalamala kare — glitters; anga-chhataya — with the radiance of His body; saba geha — the whole house

14Vishvambhara's whole body is filled with thrills,
and the whole house glitters with the radiance of His body.4

হেনকালে নিত্যানন্দ অবধূত রায় ।
শ্রীনিবাস-ঘর হৈতে মিলিলা তথায় ॥ ১৫ ॥

henakāle nityānanda abadhūta rāẏa |
śrīnibāsa-ghara haite mililā tathāẏa || 15 ||

henakale — at that time; nityananda avadhuta raya — Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya; shrinivasa-ghara haite — from Srinivasa's house; milila tathaya — arrived there

15At that time Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya
came there from Srinivasa's house.

আসিয়া দেখিল প্রভুর সুন্দর শরীর ।
তেজোময় মহাবাহু এ নাভি গভীর ॥ ১৬ ॥

āsiẏā dekhila prabhura sundara śarīra |
tejomaẏa mahābāhu e nābhi gabhīra || 16 ||

asiya dekhila — coming, He saw; prabhura sundara sharira — the Lord's beautiful body; tejomaya mahabahu — radiant, mighty-armed; e nabhi gabhira — with a deep navel

16Coming, He saw the Lord's beautiful body:
radiant, mighty-armed, with a deep navel;

দক্ষিণ করেতে গদা বামকরে বেণু ।
করতলে পদ্ম বামকরতলে ধনু ॥ ১৭ ॥

dakṣiṇa karete gadā bāmakare beṇu |
karatale padma bāmakaratale dhanu || 17 ||

dakshina karete gada — a club in His right hand; vama-kare venu — a flute in His left hand; karatale padma — a lotus in His palm; vama-karatale dhanu — a bow in His left palm

17in His right hand a club, in His left hand a flute,
in His palm a lotus, in His left palm a bow;

তপতকাঞ্চন-কান্তি হৃদয়ে কৌস্তুভ ।
মকর-কুণ্ডল দুই শোভে গণ্ডযুগ ॥ ১৮ ॥

tapatakāñcana-kānti hṛdaẏe kaustubha |
makara-kuṇḍala dui śobhe gaṇḍayuga || 18 ||

tapata-kanchana-kanti — the lustre of molten gold; hridaye kaustubha — the Kaustubha on His breast; makara-kundala dui — two makara-shaped earrings; shobhe ganda-yuga — adorn His cheeks

18His lustre like molten gold, the Kaustubha on His breast,
two makara-shaped earrings adorning His cheeks;

মরকত-দ্যুতি হার শোভয়ে গলায় ।
অদ্ভুত বেশ দেখি' অবধূত রায় ॥ ১৯ ॥

marakata-dyuti hāra śobhaẏe galāẏa |
adbhuta beśa dekhi' abadhūta rāẏa || 19 ||

marakata-dyuti hara — a necklace with the lustre of emerald; shobhaye galaya — adorns His neck; adbhuta vesha dekhi — seeing the wondrous attire; avadhuta raya — the Avadhuta-raya

19a necklace with the lustre of emerald adorning His neck —
such wondrous attire the Avadhuta-raya beholds.

চতুর্ভুজ দেখি' ধনু মুরলিকা নাই ।
সেইমত রূপ সব বর চারি বাই ॥ ২০ ॥

caturbhuja dekhi' dhanu muralikā nāi |
seimata rūpa saba bara cāri bāi || 20 ||

chaturbhuja dekhi — He sees Him four-armed; dhanu muralika nai — without bow and flute; seimata rupa saba — the form all the same; vara chari bai — with four excellent arms

20Then He sees Him four-armed — without the bow and flute:
the form all the same, with four excellent arms.

ক্ষণেক অন্তরে দেখে দ্বিভুজ-আকার ।
লোক-অনুগ্রহ-রূপ চরিত্র তাহার ॥ ২১ ॥

kṣaṇeka antare dekhe dbibhuja-ākāra |
loka-anugraha-rūpa caritra tāhāra || 21 ||

kshaneka antare — a moment later; dekhe dvibhuja-akara — He sees the two-armed form; loka-anugraha-rupa — a form of grace to the world; charitra tahara — and His deeds

21A moment later He sees Him two-armed —
in a form and deeds gracious to the world.5

এ রূপ দেখিয়া সেই অবধূত রায় ।
নিজজনে আলিঙ্গন দিয়া নাচে গায় ॥ ২২ ॥

e rūpa dekhiẏā sei abadhūta rāẏa |
nijajane āliṅgana diẏā nāce gāẏa || 22 ||

e rupa dekhiya — seeing this form; sei avadhuta raya — the Avadhuta-raya; nijajane alingana diya — embracing His own; nache gaya — dances and sings

22Seeing this form, the Avadhuta-raya
embraces His own, dances and sings.

আবেশে নাচেন সেই বিবশ হইয়া ।
প্রেম-মহাজলনিধি প্রবেশ করিয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

ābeśe nācena sei bibaśa haiẏā |
prema-mahājalanidhi prabeśa kariẏā || 23 ||

aveshe nachena — He dances in rapture; sei vibasha haiya — beside Himself; prema-maha-jalanidhi — into the great ocean of prema; pravesha kariya — plunging

23In rapture He dances, beside Himself,
plunged into the great ocean of prema.

শ্রীনিবাস নারায়ণ রাম মুরারি ।
ইহা সঙ্গে তোমরা চলহ জনা চারি ॥ ২৪ ॥

śrīnibāsa nārāẏaṇa rāma murāri |
ihā saṅge tomarā calaha janā cāri || 24 ||

shrinivasa narayana rama murari — Srinivasa, Narayana, Rama, Murari; iha sange — with Him; tomara chalaha — you go; jana chari — the four of you

24[The Lord said:] "Srinivasa, Narayana, Rama, Murari,
go, the four of you, with Him.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-বাড়ী যাব অবধূত ।
ইহা জানাইহ ইহো বড় অদ্ভুত ॥ ২৫ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-bāṛī yāba abadhūta |
ihā jānāiha iho baṛa adbhuta || 25 ||

advaita-acharya-badi — to the house of Advaita Acharya; yaba avadhuta — the Avadhuta will go; iha janaiha — announce this; iho bada adbhuta — He is a great wonder

25The Avadhuta will go to the house of Advaita Acharya —
let Him know of it: He is a great wonder."

হেনমতে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈল ।
শুনি' সর্বজন-হিয়া আনন্দিত হৈল ॥ ২৬ ॥

henamate mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kaila |
śuni' sarbajana-hiẏā ānandita haila || 26 ||

henamate — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu gave the command; shuni — hearing; sarvajana-hiya — the hearts of all; anandita haila — rejoiced

26When Mahaprabhu gave this command,
the hearts of all who heard it rejoiced.

নিত্যানন্দ-সঙ্গে সভে চলিলা সত্বর ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে গেলা আচার্যের ঘর ॥ ২৭ ॥

nityānanda-saṅge sabhe calilā satbara |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe gelā ācāryera ghara || 27 ||

nityananda-sange — with Nityananda; sabhe chalila satvara — all set off quickly; ananda-hridaye — with joyful hearts; gela acharyera ghara — went to the Acharya's house

27All set off quickly with Nityananda
and with joyful hearts came to the Acharya's house.

পরণাম করি' কথা কহিল সকল ।
শুনিঞা আচার্য সুখে নাচয়ে বিহ্বল ॥ ২৮ ॥

paraṇāma kari' kathā kahila sakala |
śuniñā ācārya sukhe nācaẏe bihbala || 28 ||

paranama kari — bowing down; katha kahila sakala — they told everything; shuninya acharya — hearing, the Acharya; sukhe nachaye vihvala — dances in bliss, overwhelmed

28Bowing down, they told everything;
hearing it, the Acharya dances in bliss, beside Himself.

দোঁহে দোঁহা আলিঙ্গন করয়ে আনন্দে ।
আচার্য নাচয়ে সুখে নাচে নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ২৯ ॥

doṁhe doṁhā āliṅgana karaẏe ānande |
ācārya nācaẏe sukhe nāce nityānande || 29 ||

donhe donha alingana karaye — they embrace each other; anande — in joy; acharya nachaye sukhe — the Acharya dances happily; nache nityanande — Nityananda dances

29Both joyfully embrace each other:
the Acharya dances happily, Nityananda dances.

আনন্দ-সমুদ্রে সুখে ডুবিলা নির্ভরে ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার উঠয়ে হিল্লোলে ॥ ৩০ ॥

ānanda-samudre sukhe ḍubilā nirbhare |
ghana ghana huhuṅkāra uṭhaẏe hillole || 30 ||

ananda-samudre — in the ocean of bliss; sukhe dubila nirbhare — they sank wholly in happiness; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again the roar "hum!"; uthaye hillole — rises in waves

30Happily They sank wholly into the ocean of bliss:
again and again roars of "hum!" rise up in waves.

দোঁহে গুপ্তকথা কহে গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত ।
কহিতে শুনিতে দোঁহে উনমত-চিত ॥ ৩১ ॥

doṁhe guptakathā kahe gaurāṅga-carita |
kahite śunite doṁhe unamata-cita || 31 ||

donhe gupta-katha kahe — both speak confidentially; gauranga-charita — of Gauranga's deeds; kahite shunite — telling and hearing; donhe unamata-chita — both are enraptured at heart

31Both speak confidentially of Gauranga's deeds;
telling and hearing, both are enraptured at heart.

এইমত আনন্দে আছিলা দিন দুই ।
আনন্দে বৈষ্ণব সব গোরাগুণ গাই ॥ ৩২ ॥

eimata ānande āchilā dina dui |
ānande baiṣṇaba saba gorāguṇa gāi || 32 ||

eimata — thus; anande achhila dina dui — they spent two days in joy; anande vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas joyfully; gora-guna gai — singing of Gora's qualities

32So they spent two days in joy;
all the Vaishnavas joyfully sang of Gora's qualities.

অদ্বৈত-চরণে পুনঃ নিবেদন করি' ।
চলিলা সত্বরে দেখিবারে গৌরহরি ॥ ৩৩ ॥

adbaita-caraṇe punaḥ nibedana kari' |
calilā satbare dekhibāre gaurahari || 33 ||

advaita-charane — at Advaita's feet; punah nivedana kari — again submitting [their request]; chalila satvare — they set off quickly; dekhibare gaurahari — to see Gaurahari

33Again respectfully asking leave at Advaita's feet,
they hurried to see Gaurahari.

প্রভুর সম্মুখে আসি' পরণাম করি' ।
করজোড় করি' সব কহয়ে মুরারি ॥ ৩৪ ॥

prabhura sammukhe āsi' paraṇāma kari' |
karajoṛa kari' saba kahaẏe murāri || 34 ||

prabhura sammukhe asi — coming before the Lord; paranama kari — bowing down; karajoda kari — with joined palms; saba kahaye murari — Murari tells everything

34Coming before the Lord and bowing down,
with joined palms Murari tells everything:

আচার্যের ঘরে যত হৈল রহস্য ।
শুনি' আনন্দিত প্রভু উপজিল হাস্য ॥ ৩৫ ॥

ācāryera ghare yata haila rahasya |
śuni' ānandita prabhu upajila hāsya || 35 ||

acharyera ghare — in the Acharya's house; yata haila rahasya — all the confidential play that took place; shuni — hearing; anandita prabhu — the Lord was delighted; upajila hasya — laughter arose

35all the confidential play that took place in the Acharya's house;
hearing it, the Lord was delighted and laughed.6

তার-পর-দিনে পুনঃ আপনে আচার্য ।
পাদাম্বুজ দেখিতে আইলা দ্বিজবর্য ॥ ৩৬ ॥

tāra-para-dine punaḥ āpane ācārya |
pādāmbuja dekhite āilā dbijabarya || 36 ||

tara-para-dine — the next day; punah apane acharya — the Acharya Himself; padambuja dekhite — to see the lotus feet; aila dvijavarya — came, the best of brahmanas

36The next day the Acharya Himself, the best of brahmanas,
came to see His lotus feet.

শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিতের ঘরে মহাপ্রভু ।
দেবতার ঘর মধ্যে বসি' হাসে লহু ॥ ৩৭ ॥

śrīnibāsa-paṇḍitera ghare mahāprabhu |
debatāra ghara madhye basi' hāse lahu || 37 ||

shrinivasa-panditera ghare — in Srinivasa Pandita's house; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; devatara ghara madhye — in the shrine room; basi hase lahu — sitting, smiles gently

37In the house of Srinivasa Pandita Mahaprabhu
sits in the shrine room, smiling gently.

দিব্যাসনে পহুঁ বসিয়াছে মহাসুখে ।
ঝলমল করে ঘর অঙ্গের ছটাকে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

dibyāsane pahuṁ basiẏāche mahāsukhe |
jhalamala kare ghara aṅgera chaṭāke || 38 ||

divya-asane — on a divine seat; pahu basiyachhe — the Lord is seated; maha-sukhe — in great joy; jhalamala kare ghara — the room glitters; angera chhatake — with the radiance of His body

38The Lord sits in great joy on a divine seat;
the room glitters with the radiance of His body.

তপত-কাঞ্চন যেন শ্রীঅঙ্গের ছবি ।
প্রেমার অরুণ যেন প্রভাতের রবি ॥ ৩৯ ॥

tapata-kāñcana yena śrīaṅgera chabi |
premāra aruṇa yena prabhātera rabi || 39 ||

tapata-kanchana yena — like molten gold; shri-angera chhavi — the beauty of His holy body; premara aruna — ruddy with prema; yena prabhatera ravi — like the morning sun

39The beauty of His holy body is like molten gold,
ruddy with prema, like the morning sun.

দিব্য অলঙ্কার মালা সুগন্ধি চন্দন ।
পূর্ণিমার চন্দ্র জিনি' সুন্দর বদন ॥ ৪০ ॥

dibya alaṅkāra mālā sugandhi candana |
pūrṇimāra candra jini' sundara badana || 40 ||

divya alankara mala — divine ornaments, garlands; sugandhi chandana — fragrant sandal; purnimara chandra jini — surpassing the full moon; sundara vadana — His beautiful face

40Divine ornaments, garlands, fragrant sandal;
His beautiful face surpasses the full moon.

গদাধর নরহরি দুইদিগে রহে ।
শ্রীরঘুনন্দন যে শ্রীমুখচন্দ্র চাহে ॥ ৪১ ॥

gadādhara narahari duidige rahe |
śrīraghunandana ye śrīmukhacandra cāhe || 41 ||

gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; duidige rahe — stand on both sides; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; ye shri-mukha-chandra chahe — gazes at the moon of His face

41Gadadhara and Narahari stand on both sides,
and Sri Raghunandana gazes at the moon of His face.7

চৌদিগে বেঢ়িয়া ভক্তগণ তার পাশে ।
নক্ষত্র বেঢ়িল যেন দ্বিজরাজ হাসে ॥ ৪২ ॥

caudige beṛhiẏā bhaktagaṇa tāra pāśe |
nakṣatra beṛhila yena dbijarāja hāse || 42 ||

chaudige bedhiya — surrounding on all sides; bhaktagana tara pashe — the devotees beside Him; nakshatra bedhila yena — as if surrounded by stars; dvijaraja hase — the moon shines

42All around Him are the devotees,
like the shining moon in a ring of stars.

নিত্যানন্দ বসিয়া সম্মুখে প্রেমানন্দে ।
বদন হেরিয়া ঘন ঘন হাসে কান্দে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

nityānanda basiẏā sammukhe premānande |
badana heriẏā ghana ghana hāse kānde || 43 ||

nityananda basiya sammukhe — Nityananda, sitting before Him; premanande — in the bliss of prema; vadana heriya — gazing at [His] face; ghana ghana hase kande — again and again laughs and weeps

43Nityananda, sitting before Him in the bliss of prema,
gazes at His face and again and again laughs and weeps.

হেনই সময়ে দেখি' আচার্য দ্বিজচাঁদ ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার ছাড়ে সিংহনাদ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

henai samaẏe dekhi' ācārya dbijacāṁda |
ghana ghana huhuṅkāra chāṛe siṃhanāda || 44 ||

henai samaye — at that very time; dekhi — seeing [Him]; acharya dvija-chanda — the Acharya, moon among brahmanas; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again "hum!"; chhade simhanada — lets out a lion's roar

44At that very time, seeing [Him], the Acharya, the moon among brahmanas,
again and again roars "hum!" and lets out a lion's roar.

পুলকে ভরিল অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তার অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ৪৫ ॥

pulake bharila aṅga āpāda-mastaka |
brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāra antara-kautuka || 45 ||

pulake bharila anga — His body filled with thrills; apada-mastaka — from feet to head; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain; tara antara-kautuka — the joy of His heart

45His body from feet to head filled with thrills;
the universe cannot contain the joy of His heart.

নিবেদন কৈল দ্বিজ নানা উপায়ন ।
পাদাম্বুজে দিল নব্য দিব্য যে বসন ॥ ৪৬ ॥

nibedana kaila dbija nānā upāẏana |
pādāmbuje dila nabya dibya ye basana || 46 ||

nivedana kaila dvija — the brahmana offered; nana upayana — various gifts; padambuje dila — placed at the lotus feet; navya divya ye basana — new divine garments

46The brahmana offered various gifts
and laid new divine garments at His lotus feet.

তুলসী-মঞ্জরী দিয়া পূজিল চরণ ।
সুগন্ধি মালতীর মালা সুগন্ধি চন্দন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

tulasī-mañjarī diẏā pūjila caraṇa |
sugandhi mālatīra mālā sugandhi candana || 47 ||

tulasi-manjari diya — with tulasi blossoms; pujila charana — He worshipped the feet; sugandhi malatira mala — with a fragrant garland of malati; sugandhi chandana — with fragrant sandal

47With tulasi blossoms He worshipped His feet,
with a fragrant garland of malati and with fragrant sandal.

দণ্ড-পরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ।
আপনে সে মহাপ্রভু তুলিলা ধরিয়া ॥ ৪৮ ॥

daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā |
āpane se mahāprabhu tulilā dhariẏā || 48 ||

danda-paranama kare — He prostrates like a rod; bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; apane se mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu Himself; tulila dhariya — lifted Him up, taking hold of Him

48He prostrates, falling on the ground like a rod —
and Mahaprabhu Himself lifted Him up.

পূজা পরিগ্রহ করি' গৌর ভগবান্ ।
অবশেষ দিল নিজ ভক্তগণে দান ॥ ৪৯ ॥

pūjā parigraha kari' gaura bhagabān |
abaśeṣa dila nija bhaktagaṇe dāna || 49 ||

puja parigraha kari — accepting the worship; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; avashesha dila — gave the remnants; nija bhaktagane dana — as a gift to His devotees

49Accepting the worship, Gaura Bhagavan
gave the remnants as a gift to His devotees.

সেই বস্ত্র অলঙ্কার শোভয়ে শ্রীঅঙ্গে ।
হরি হরি বলি' নাচে তা সভার সঙ্গে ॥ ৫০ ॥

sei bastra alaṅkāra śobhaẏe śrīaṅge |
hari hari bali' nāce tā sabhāra saṅge || 50 ||

sei vastra alankara — those garments and ornaments; shobhaye shri-ange — adorn His holy body; hari hari bali — crying "Hari, Hari!"; nache ta sabhara sange — He dances with them all

50Those garments and ornaments adorn His holy body;
crying "Hari, Hari!", He dances with them all.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আর নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
শ্রীনিবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ গুণ গায় ॥ ৫১ ॥

adbaita-ācārya āra nityānandarāẏa |
śrīnibāsa murāri mukunda guṇa gāẏa || 51 ||

advaita-acharya ara nityananda-raya — Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya; shrinivasa murari mukunda — Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda; guna gaya — sing His qualities

51Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya,
Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda sing His qualities.

সকল বৈষ্ণব মেলি' আনন্দ-উল্লাসে ।
আপনা পাসরে সভে রসের আবেশে ॥ ৫২ ॥

sakala baiṣṇaba meli' ānanda-ullāse |
āpanā pāsare sabhe rasera ābeśe || 52 ||

sakala vaishnava meli — all the Vaishnavas together; ananda-ullase — in joyful exultation; apana pasare sabhe — all forget themselves; rasera aveshe — absorbed in rasa

52All the Vaishnavas together in joyful exultation
forget themselves, absorbed in rasa.

সভে সভা পরশংসে বলে ধন্য ধন্য ।
তুচ্ছ করি' মানে সুখ কৈবল্য নির্বাণ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

sabhe sabhā paraśaṃse bale dhanya dhanya |
tuccha kari' māne sukha kaibalya nirbāṇa || 53 ||

sabhe sabha parashamse — all praise one another; bale dhanya dhanya — saying "Blessed, blessed!"; tuchchha kari mane — they deem insignificant; sukha kaivalya nirvana — the happiness of kaivalya and nirvana

53All praise one another: "Blessed, blessed!" —
and deem the happiness of kaivalya and nirvana insignificant.

দিবানিশি না জানয়ে প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ।
নিয়ত বিহ্বল তারা অন্তর-কৌতুকে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

dibāniśi nā jānaẏe premānanda-sukhe |
niẏata bihbala tārā antara-kautuke || 54 ||

divanishi na janaye — they know neither day nor night; premananda-sukhe — in the happiness of prema's bliss; niyata vihvala tara — they are ever overwhelmed; antara-kautuke — with inner joy

54In the happiness of prema's bliss they know neither day nor night,
ever overwhelmed with inner joy.

সূর্যোদয়ে নৃত্যারম্ভ হয়ে ত রজনী ।
সন্ধ্যায় নাচয়ে সে অবধি দিনমণি ॥ ৫৫ ॥

sūryodaẏe nṛtyārambha haẏe ta rajanī |
sandhyāẏa nācaẏe se abadhi dinamaṇi || 55 ||

suryodaye nrityarambha — the dance begins at sunrise; haye ta rajani — and night comes; sandhyaya nachaye — they dance from evening; se avadhi dina-mani — until the [next] sun

55The dance begins at sunrise and lasts into the night;
from evening they dance until the next dawn.8

হেনমনে রাত্রিদিনে প্রেমানন্দে ভোরা ।
নৃত্য-অবসানে সভে আজ্ঞা দিল গোরা ॥ ৫৬ ॥

henamane rātridine premānande bhorā |
nṛtya-abasāne sabhe ājñā dila gorā || 56 ||

henamane — thus; ratridine — night and day; premanande bhora — immersed in the bliss of prema; nritya-avasane — at the end of the dance; sabhe ajna dila gora — Gora commanded all

56So night and day they are immersed in the bliss of prema.
When the dance ended, Gora commanded all:

স্নান দেবার্চনা সভে কর নিজ ঘরে ।
পুনরপি আইস সভে ভোজন-অন্তরে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

snāna debārcanā sabhe kara nija ghare |
punarapi āisa sabhe bhojana-antare || 57 ||

snana devarchana — bathing and worship of the Deity; sabhe kara nija ghare — all perform in your own homes; punarapi aisa sabhe — come again, all; bhojana-antare — after the meal

57"Bathe and worship the Deity, all of you, in your own homes,
and after your meal come again."

সেইমত সর্বজন ক্রিয়া সমাধিয়া ।
পাদাম্বুজ-সন্নিকটে মিলিলা আসিয়া ॥ ৫৮ ॥

seimata sarbajana kriẏā samādhiẏā |
pādāmbuja-sannikaṭe mililā āsiẏā || 58 ||

seimata sarvajana — so all; kriya samadhiya — having completed their rites; padambuja-sannikate — near the lotus feet; milila asiya — came and assembled

58So all, having completed their rites,
came and assembled at His lotus feet.

হেনই সময়ে মহাশয় হরিদাস ।
কৃষ্ণনামে নিরন্তর অন্তর-উল্লাস ॥ ৫৯ ॥

henai samaẏe mahāśaẏa haridāsa |
kṛṣṇanāme nirantara antara-ullāsa || 59 ||

henai samaye — at that very time; mahashaya haridasa — the great-souled Haridasa; krishna-name — in the name of Krishna; nirantara antara-ullasa — ceaseless inner exultation

59At that very time the great-souled Haridasa,
whose heart ceaselessly exults in the name of Krishna —

কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজ-মধুময় মত্ত ভৃঙ্গ ।
রসের আবেশে হয় তরুণিম সিংহ ॥ ৬০ ॥

kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuja-madhumaẏa matta bhṛṅga |
rasera ābeśe haẏa taruṇima siṃha || 60 ||

krishna-padambuja-madhumaya — with the honey of Krishna's lotus feet; matta bhringa — an intoxicated bee; rasera aveshe — in absorption in rasa; haya tarunima simha — he becomes a young lion

60a bee intoxicated with the honey of Krishna's lotus feet,
who in absorption in rasa becomes a young lion —

আচম্বিতে নবদ্বীপে মিলিলা আসিয়া ।
আইস আইস বলি' প্রভু সম্ভাষে হাসিয়া ॥ ৬১ ॥

ācambite nabadbīpe mililā āsiẏā |
āisa āisa bali' prabhu sambhāṣe hāsiẏā || 61 ||

achambite — suddenly; navadvipe milila asiya — arrived in Navadvipa; aisa aisa bali — saying "Come, come!"; prabhu sambhashe hasiya — the Lord greets him, laughing

61suddenly arrived in Navadvipa.
"Come, come!" the Lord greets him, laughing.

নির্ভর-প্রেমায় কৈল গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন ।
আদেশিলা মহাপ্রভু বসিতে আসন ॥ ৬২ ॥

nirbhara-premāẏa kaila gāṛha āliṅgana |
ādeśilā mahāprabhu basite āsana || 62 ||

nirbhara-premaya — with full love; kaila gadha alingana — embraced him tightly; adeshila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu bade; basite asana — to sit on a seat

62With full love He embraced him tightly,
and Mahaprabhu bade him sit down.

চতুর সে হরিদাস পরণাম করে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর তার কর ধরি' তোলে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

catura se haridāsa paraṇāma kare |
āpane ṭhākura tāra kara dhari' tole || 63 ||

chatura se haridasa — the wise Haridasa; paranama kare — bows down; apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; tara kara dhari tole — taking his hand, raises him

63The wise Haridasa bows down,
and the Thakura Himself, taking his hand, raises him.

সুগন্ধি চন্দন অঙ্গে লেপিল তাহার ।
অঙ্গের প্রসাদী মালা দিল আপনার ॥ ৬৪ ॥

sugandhi candana aṅge lepila tāhāra |
aṅgera prasādī mālā dila āpanāra || 64 ||

sugandhi chandana — with fragrant sandal; ange lepila tahara — anointed his body; angera prasadi mala — the prasada garland from His own body; dila apanara — He gave His own

64He anointed his body with fragrant sandal
and gave him His own prasada garland from His body.

ভোজন করিতে আজ্ঞা দিলেন ঠাকুর ।
ভোজন করিল মহাপ্রসাদ প্রচুর ॥ ৬৫ ॥

bhojana karite ājñā dilena ṭhākura |
bhojana karila mahāprasāda pracura || 65 ||

bhojana karite — to eat; ajna dilena thakura — the Thakura bade; bhojana karila — he ate; mahaprasada prachura — abundant mahaprasada

65The Thakura bade him eat,
and he partook of abundant mahaprasada.9

এইমতে হরিনাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তন ।
বিলসয়ে মহাপ্রভু আনন্দিত মন ॥ ৬৬ ॥

eimate harināma-guṇa-saṃkīrtana |
bilasaẏe mahāprabhu ānandita mana || 66 ||

eimate — thus; hari-nama-guna-sankirtana — in the sankirtana of Hari's name and qualities; vilasaye mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu delights; anandita mana — with a joyful heart

66So Mahaprabhu with a joyful heart
delights in the sankirtana of Hari's name and qualities,

হরিদাস অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নিত্যানন্দ ।
শ্রীনিবাস-আদি যত নিজজনবৃন্দ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

haridāsa adbaita-ācārya nityānanda |
śrīnibāsa-ādi yata nijajanabṛnda || 67 ||

haridasa advaita-acharya nityananda — Haridasa, Advaita Acharya, Nityananda; shrinivasa-adi — Srinivasa and others; yata nijajana-vrinda — all His own

67[with Him] Haridasa, Advaita Acharya, Nityananda,
Srinivasa and all the rest of His own.

প্রেমানন্দ-কৌতুকে গোঙাইল দিনরাতি ।
আচার্যে বিদায় দিল ঘর যাহ আজি ॥ ৬৮ ॥

premānanda-kautuke goṅāila dinarāti |
ācārye bidāẏa dila ghara yāha āji || 68 ||

premananda-kautuke — in joyful play of prema's bliss; gongaila dinarati — they passed days and nights; acharye vidaya dila — He bade the Acharya farewell; ghara yaha aji — go home today

68Days and nights they passed in joyful play of prema's bliss.
[At last the Lord] dismissed the Acharya: "Go home today."

আজ্ঞা পাই' অদ্বৈত-আচার্য ঘর গেলা ।
যে দেখিল যে শুনিল সেই সুখে ভোলা ॥ ৬৯ ॥

ājñā pāi' adbaita-ācārya ghara gelā |
ye dekhila ye śunila sei sukhe bholā || 69 ||

ajna pai — receiving the command; advaita-acharya ghara gela — Advaita Acharya went home; ye dekhila ye shunila — what He had seen and heard; sei sukhe bhola — lost in that happiness

69Receiving the command, Advaita Acharya went home,
lost in happiness at all He had seen and heard.

তবে সেই নিত্যানন্দ অবধূতরায় ।
প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে তেঁহো হইলা বিদায় ॥ ৭০ ॥

tabe sei nityānanda abadhūtarāẏa |
prabhu-bidyamāne teṁho hailā bidāẏa || 70 ||

tabe — then; sei nityananda avadhuta-raya — Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya; prabhu-vidyamane — before the Lord; tenho haila vidaya — took His leave

70Then Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya
took leave of the Lord.

তার সঙ্গে অনুব্রজি' চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
প্রেমে পালটিতে নারে গেলা বহুদূর ॥ ৭১ ॥

tāra saṅge anubraji' calilā ṭhākura |
preme pālaṭite nāre gelā bahudūra || 71 ||

tara sange — with Him; anuvraji chalila thakura — the Thakura went along to see Him off; preme palatite nare — from love cannot turn back; gela bahudura — went far

71The Thakura went along to see Him off;
from love He cannot turn back and went far.

ছাড়িয়া যাইতে নারে অবধূতরায় ।
অনেক যতনে তেঁহো করিলা বিদায় ॥ ৭২ ॥

chāṛiẏā yāite nāre abadhūtarāẏa |
aneka yatane teṁho karilā bidāẏa || 72 ||

chhadiya yaite nare — cannot leave [Him] and go; avadhuta-raya — the Avadhuta-raya; aneka yatane — with great effort; tenho karila vidaya — He took leave

72The Avadhuta-raya cannot bring Himself to leave [Him] and go;
with great effort He took His leave.

বিদায়-সময়ে প্রভু কহে এক বাণী ।
এ সভারে দেহ ত কৌপীন একখানি ॥ ৭৩ ॥

bidāẏa-samaẏe prabhu kahe eka bāṇī |
e sabhāre deha ta kaupīna ekakhāni || 73 ||

vidaya-samaye — at the time of parting; prabhu kahe eka vani — the Lord speaks a word; e sabhare — to all these; deha ta kaupina ekakhani — give one kaupina

73At the parting the Lord says:
"Give them all one kaupina."

প্রভুর বচনে সে ঠাকুর অবধূত ।
সভাকারে দিলেন কৌপীন অদ্ভুত ॥ ৭৪ ॥

prabhura bacane se ṭhākura abadhūta |
sabhākāre dilena kaupīna adbhuta || 74 ||

prabhura bachane — at the Lord's word; se thakura avadhuta — the Thakura Avadhuta; sabhakare dilena — gave for all; kaupina adbhuta — a wondrous kaupina

74At the Lord's word the Thakura Avadhuta
gave them all a wondrous kaupina.

আপনে কৌপীন প্রভু নিল ত হাসিয়া ।
নিজভক্তজনে দিল সভারে বাঁটিয়া ॥ ৭৫ ॥

āpane kaupīna prabhu nila ta hāsiẏā |
nijabhaktajane dila sabhāre bāṁṭiẏā || 75 ||

apane kaupina prabhu — the Lord Himself the kaupina; nila ta hasiya — took, laughing; nija-bhakta-jane — to His devotees; dila sabhare bantiya — dividing it, gave to all

75The Lord Himself, laughing, took the kaupina,
divided it and gave it to all His devotees.

কৌপীন-প্রসাদ তারা পাইয়া কৌতুকে ।
আনন্দ করিয়া সভে বান্ধিল মস্তকে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

kaupīna-prasāda tārā pāiẏā kautuke |
ānanda kariẏā sabhe bāndhila mastake || 76 ||

kaupina-prasada — the kaupina as prasada; tara paiya kautuke — receiving it joyfully; ananda kariya — rejoicing; sabhe bandhila mastake — all tied it on their heads

76Receiving this kaupina joyfully as grace,
all, rejoicing, tied it on their heads.10

নিত্যানন্দ-পাদাম্বুজে লইয়া বিদায় ।
প্রভুর সংহতি তারা নিজ ঘরে যায় ॥ ৭৭ ॥

nityānanda-pādāmbuje laiẏā bidāẏa |
prabhura saṃhati tārā nija ghare yāẏa || 77 ||

nityananda-padambuje — at Nityananda's lotus feet; laiya vidaya — taking leave; prabhura samhati — together with the Lord; tara nija ghare yaya — they go home

77Taking leave at Nityananda's lotus feet,
they go home together with the Lord.

ঘরেরে আইলা সভে দুঃখিত-হৃদয় ।
বাষ্প-ছলছল আঁখি বসিলা আলয় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

gharere āilā sabhe duḥkhita-hṛdaẏa |
bāṣpa-chalachala āṁkhi basilā ālaẏa || 78 ||

gharere aila sabhe — all came home; duhkhita-hridaya — with sorrowful hearts; bashpa-chhalachhala ankhi — eyes brimming with tears; basila alaya — they sat in the house

78All came home with sorrowful hearts
and sit in their houses, their eyes brimming with tears.

কথোক্ষণে সভে স্নান-দেবার্চন করি' ।
সন্ধ্যাকালে আইলা দেখিবারে গৌরহরি ॥ ৭৯ ॥

kathokṣaṇe sabhe snāna-debārcana kari' |
sandhyākāle āilā dekhibāre gaurahari || 79 ||

kathokshane — after a while; sabhe snana-devarchana kari — all, having bathed and worshipped the Deity; sandhya-kale aila — came in the evening; dekhibare gaurahari — to see Gaurahari

79After a while, having bathed and worshipped the Deity,
in the evening all came to see Gaurahari.

নিত্যানন্দ আইলা আচার্য-গোসাঞির স্থানে ।
হরিষে গোরা-কথা কহে রাতিদিনে ॥ ৮০ ॥

nityānanda āilā ācārya-gosāñira sthāne |
hariṣe gorā-kathā kahe rātidine || 80 ||

nityananda aila — Nityananda came; acharya-gosanyira sthane — to Acharya Gosani; harishe — joyfully; gora-katha kahe ratidine — speaks of Gora day and night

80And Nityananda went to Acharya Gosani
and joyfully speaks of Gora day and night.

তার-পর-দিনে এক কথা শুন সভে ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-চরণে প্রেমভক্তি পাবে তবে ॥ ৮১ ॥

tāra-para-dine eka kathā śuna sabhe |
śrīkṛṣṇa-caraṇe premabhakti pābe tabe || 81 ||

tara-para-dine — on the next day; eka katha shuna sabhe — hear, all, a story; shri-krishna-charane — at Sri Krishna's feet; prema-bhakti pabe tabe — then you will attain prema-bhakti

81Hear, all of you, the story of the next day —
then you will attain prema-bhakti at the feet of Sri Krishna.

লোক-বেদ-অগোচর অপরূপ কথা ।
অমৃতের সার এই গোরা-গুণগাথা ॥ ৮২ ॥

loka-beda-agocara aparūpa kathā |
amṛtera sāra ei gorā-guṇagāthā || 82 ||

loka-veda-agochara — beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas; aparupa katha — a wondrous story; amritera sara — the essence of nectar; ei gora-guna-gatha — this song of Gora's qualities

82It is a wondrous story, beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas;
this song of Gora's qualities is the essence of nectar.

দেখি' নিজজন প্রভু আলিঙ্গন দিয়া ।
আপনার গুণ শুনি' বুলয়ে নাচিয়া ॥ ৮৩ ॥

dekhi' nijajana prabhu āliṅgana diẏā |
āpanāra guṇa śuni' bulaẏe nāciẏā || 83 ||

dekhi nijajana — seeing His own; prabhu alingana diya — the Lord, embracing [them]; apanara guna shuni — hearing of His own qualities; bulaye nachiya — moves about dancing

83Seeing His own, the Lord embraces them
and, hearing of His own qualities, moves about dancing.

চতুর্দিগে সর্বজন সুখে নাচে গায় ।
আনন্দে বিভোর মাঝে নাচে গোরারায় ॥ ৮৪ ॥

caturdige sarbajana sukhe nāce gāẏa |
ānande bibhora mājhe nāce gorārāẏa || 84 ||

chaturdige sarvajana — all around, everyone; sukhe nache gaya — happily dance and sing; anande vibhora — absorbed in bliss; majhe nache goraraya — in the middle dances Gora-raya

84All around, everyone happily dances and sings,
and in the middle, absorbed in bliss, Gora-raya dances.

আচম্বিতে শ্রীনিবাস কর ধরি' করে ।
কতি গেলা নাহি জানি প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

ācambite śrīnibāsa kara dhari' kare |
kati gelā nāhi jāni prabhu biśbambhare || 85 ||

achambite — suddenly; shrinivasa kara dhari kare — taking Srinivasa's hand in His hand; kati gela nahi jani — where He went, no one knows; prabhu vishvambhare — the Lord Vishvambhara

85Suddenly the Lord Vishvambhara, taking Srinivasa by the hand,
went off — no one knows where.

চতুর্দিগে সর্বজন নাচিতে গাইতে ।
মধ্যে মহাপ্রভু নাই না পাই দেখিতে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

caturdige sarbajana nācite gāite |
madhye mahāprabhu nāi nā pāi dekhite || 86 ||

chaturdige sarvajana — all around, everyone; nachite gaite — dancing and singing; madhye mahaprabhu nai — Mahaprabhu is not in the middle; na pai dekhite — they cannot see Him

86All around, everyone is dancing and singing,
but Mahaprabhu is not in the middle — He cannot be seen.

সর্বজন উপজিল অন্তরে তরাস ।
কান্দয়ে সকল লোক গণয়ে হতাশ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

sarbajana upajila antare tarāsa |
kāndaẏe sakala loka gaṇaẏe hatāśa || 87 ||

sarvajana upajila — in all arose; antare tarasa — fear in the heart; kandaye sakala loka — all the people weep; ganaye hatasha — they reckon [all] lost

87Fear arose in everyone's heart;
all the people weep, reckoning all lost.

ভূমিতে লোটাঞা কান্দে স্থির নাহি বান্ধে ।
নদীয়ার লোক সব গুণ ঝুরি' কান্দে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

bhūmite loṭāñā kānde sthira nāhi bāndhe |
nadīẏāra loka saba guṇa jhuri' kānde || 88 ||

bhumite lotanya kande — rolling on the ground they weep; sthira nahi bandhe — they find no calm; nadiyara loka saba — all the people of Nadia; guna jhuri kande — weep, recalling [His] qualities

88Rolling on the ground they weep and find no calm;
all the people of Nadia weep, recalling His qualities.

ধাওয়াধাই সর্বলোক চাহে ঘরে ঘরে ।
আঁখি মেলিবারে নারে নয়নের জলে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

dhāoẏādhāi sarbaloka cāhe ghare ghare |
āṁkhi melibāre nāre naẏanera jale || 89 ||

dhaoyadhai sarvaloka — everyone running about; chahe ghare ghare — searches from house to house; ankhi melibare nare — cannot open their eyes; nayanera jale — for the tears

89Everyone runs about searching from house to house,
unable to open their eyes for the tears.

বিষ খাই' সর্বজন মরিব আমরা ।
কি লাগিয়া কতি গেলা আমার প্রভু গোরা ॥ ৯০ ॥

biṣa khāi' sarbajana mariba āmarā |
ki lāgiẏā kati gelā āmāra prabhu gorā || 90 ||

visha khai — taking poison; sarvajana mariba amara — we shall all die; ki lagiya — why; kati gela — where has He gone; amara prabhu gora — our Lord Gora

90"We shall take poison and all die!
Why, where has our Lord Gora gone?"

এতেক বিলাপ করে সব নিজজন ।
শুনিঞা ধাইল শচী হঞা অচেতন ॥ ৯১ ॥

eteka bilāpa kare saba nijajana |
śuniñā dhāila śacī hañā acetana || 91 ||

eteka vilapa kare — thus lament; saba nijajana — all His own; shuninya dhaila shachi — hearing, Shachi ran; hanya achetana — beside herself

91So lament all His own.
Hearing it, Shachi ran [there], beside herself.

বসন সম্বরে নাহি নাহি বান্ধে চুলি ।
বুকে কর হানি' ধায় উন্মত্ত পাগলী ॥ ৯২ ॥

basana sambare nāhi nāhi bāndhe culi |
buke kara hāni' dhāẏa unmatta pāgalī || 92 ||

basana samvare nahi — she does not arrange her clothes; nahi bandhe chuli — does not tie her hair; buke kara hani — beating her breast; dhaya unmatta pagali — runs like a madwoman

92Without arranging her clothes, without tying her hair,
beating her breast, she runs, frantic with grief.

বাপ বাপ ডাক ডাকে বলি' বিশ্বম্ভর ।
ঘরেরে আইস বেলা দ্বিতীয় প্রহর ॥ ৯৩ ॥

bāpa bāpa ḍāka ḍāke bali' biśbambhara |
gharere āisa belā dbitīẏa prahara || 93 ||

bapa bapa — "child, child!"; daka dake — she calls aloud; bali vishvambhara — calling Vishvambhara; gharere aisa — come home; bela dvitiya prahara — the time is the second watch

93"Child, child!" she calls aloud to Vishvambhara. —
"Come home: it is already the second watch of the day!

কুলের প্রদীপ মোর নদীয়ার চান্দ ।
নয়ানের তারা মোর কেবা কৈল আন্ধ ॥ ৯৪ ॥

kulera pradīpa mora nadīẏāra cānda |
naẏānera tārā mora kebā kaila āndha || 94 ||

kulera pradipa mora — the lamp of my family; nadiyara chanda — the moon of Nadia; nayanera tara mora — the pupils of my eyes; keba kaila andha — who has blinded

94Lamp of my family, moon of Nadia,
pupil of my eyes — who has blinded me?"

সর্বজন-আরতি দেখিয়া বিপরীত ।
ভকতবৎসল প্রভু আইলা আচম্বিত ॥ ৯৫ ॥

sarbajana-ārati dekhiẏā biparīta |
bhakatabatsala prabhu āilā ācambita || 95 ||

sarvajana-arati — the anguish of all; dekhiya viparita — seeing it so extreme; bhakatavatsala prabhu — the Lord, affectionate to His devotees; aila achambita — suddenly came

95Seeing the extreme anguish of all,
the Lord, affectionate to His devotees, suddenly came.

ঘোর অন্ধকারে যেন সূর্যের উদয় ।
প্রকাশ করিল প্রভু বৈষ্ণব-হৃদয় ॥ ৯৬ ॥

ghora andhakāre yena sūryera udaẏa |
prakāśa karila prabhu baiṣṇaba-hṛdaẏa || 96 ||

ghora andhakare — in pitch darkness; yena suryera udaya — like the rising of the sun; prakasha karila prabhu — the Lord illumined; vaishnava-hridaya — the hearts of the Vaishnavas

96As the sun rises in pitch darkness,
so the Lord illumined the hearts of the Vaishnavas.

চরণে পড়িয়া কেহ কান্দে আর্তনাদে ।
শ্রীমুখ দেখিয়া কেহো নাচে উনমাদে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā keha kānde ārtanāde |
śrīmukha dekhiẏā keho nāce unamāde || 97 ||

charane padiya — falling at His feet; keha kande artanade — some weep with cries of anguish; shri-mukha dekhiya — seeing His holy face; keho nache unamade — some dance in rapture

97Some, falling at His feet, weep with cries of anguish;
some, seeing His holy face, dance in rapture.

কেহো বোলে মহাপ্রভু তোর পদ বিনে ।
অন্ধকার দশদিগ না দেখি নয়নে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

keho bole mahāprabhu tora pada bine |
andhakāra daśadiga nā dekhi naẏane || 98 ||

keho bole — some say; mahaprabhu — O Mahaprabhu; tora pada vine — without Your feet; andhakara dashadiga — darkness in all ten directions; na dekhi nayane — we see nothing with our eyes

98Some say: "Mahaprabhu, without Your feet
there is darkness in all ten directions — we see nothing with our eyes."

উন্মতি পাগলী শচী পুত্র কোলে করে ।
লক্ষ লক্ষ চুম্ব দেই বদন-কমলে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

unmati pāgalī śacī putra kole kare |
lakṣa lakṣa cumba dei badana-kamale || 99 ||

unmati pagali shachi — Shachi, like one mad; putra kole kare — takes her son in her arms; laksha laksha chumba dei — gives hundreds of thousands of kisses; vadana-kamale — to [His] lotus face

99Shachi, beside herself with love, takes her son in her arms
and showers His lotus face with hundreds of thousands of kisses:

আন্ধলের লড়ি মোর দু-আঁখির তারা ।
এ দেহের আত্মা তোমা বহি নাহি মোরা ॥ ১০০ ॥

āndhalera laṛi mora du-āṁkhira tārā |
e dehera ātmā tomā bahi nāhi morā || 100 ||

andhalera ladi mora — my staff, the blind woman's; du-ankhira tara — the pupils of both my eyes; e dehera atma — the soul of this body; toma vahi nahi mora — apart from you I have none

100"You are my staff — the blind woman's — the pupil of both my eyes,
the soul of this body; apart from you I have no one.

শূন্য হইয়াছিল মোর সকল সংসার ।
গোরাচান্দ-উদয়ে ঘুচিল অন্ধকার ॥ ১০১ ॥

śūnya haiẏāchila mora sakala saṃsāra |
gorācānda-udaẏe ghucila andhakāra || 101 ||

shunya haiyachhila — had become empty; mora sakala samsara — my whole world; gorachanda-udaye — at the rising of Gorachand; ghuchila andhakara — the darkness vanished

101My whole world had become empty —
with the rising of Gorachand the darkness vanished."11

মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত আর হরিদাস ।
বিনয় করিয়া কহে শুন শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ১০২ ॥

murāri mukundadatta āra haridāsa |
binaẏa kariẏā kahe śuna śrīnibāsa || 102 ||

murari mukunda-datta ara haridasa — Murari, Mukunda Datta and Haridasa; vinaya kariya kahe — humbly say; shuna shrinivasa — hear, Srinivasa

102Murari, Mukunda Datta and Haridasa
humbly say: "Hear, Srinivasa:

তোমা বহি নাহিক প্রভুর প্রিয়দাস ।
তোমার প্রসাদে এই চরণ-প্রকাশ ॥ ১০৩ ॥

tomā bahi nāhika prabhura priẏadāsa |
tomāra prasāde ei caraṇa-prakāśa || 103 ||

toma vahi — apart from you; nahika prabhura priyadasa — the Lord has no dear servant; tomara prasade — by your grace; ei charana-prakasha — these feet have appeared

103the Lord has no servant dearer than you;
by your grace these feet have appeared [to us].

আমি-সব তোমারে বা কি কহিতে জানি ।
আপন বলিয়া দয়া করিবে আপনি ॥ ১০৪ ॥

āmi-saba tomāre bā ki kahite jāni |
āpana baliẏā daẏā karibe āpani || 104 ||

ami-saba — all of us; tomare ba ki kahite jani — what can we say to you; apana baliya — considering [us] your own; daya karibe apani — be kind yourself

104What can all of us say to you?
Considering [us] your own, be kind to us yourself."12

ইহা বলি' সভে মেলি' হরিগুণ গায় ।
পীরিতি-পাগল হঞা নাচে গোরারায় ॥ ১০৫ ॥

ihā bali' sabhe meli' hariguṇa gāẏa |
pīriti-pāgala hañā nāce gorārāẏa || 105 ||

iha bali — saying this; sabhe meli — all together; hari-guna gaya — sing Hari's qualities; piriti-pagala hanya — intoxicated with love; nache goraraya — Gora-raya dances

105Saying this, all together sing Hari's qualities,
and Gora-raya, intoxicated with love, dances.

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
নবদ্বীপে পরচার পীরিতি-রতন ॥ ১০৬ ॥

hena adbhuta kathā śuna sarbajana |
nabadbīpe paracāra pīriti-ratana || 106 ||

hena adbhuta katha — such a wondrous story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; navadvipe parachara — proclaimed in Navadvipa; piriti-ratana — the jewel of love

106Hear, all of you, this wondrous story:
in Navadvipa the jewel of love has been proclaimed.

ত্রিজগতে দুর্লভ প্রভুর প্রেমভক্তি ।
হেনজন কেবা আছে লভিবারে শক্তি ॥ ১০৭ ॥

trijagate durlabha prabhura premabhakti |
henajana kebā āche labhibāre śakti || 107 ||

trijagate durlabha — rare in the three worlds; prabhura prema-bhakti — the Lord's prema-bhakti; henajana keba achhe — who is there; labhibare shakti — with the power to attain it

107The Lord's prema-bhakti is rare in the three worlds —
who has the power to attain it?

লখিমী অনন্ত কিবা শিব সনাতন ।
যে প্রেমভক্তির কেহো না জানে মরম ॥ ১০৮ ॥

lakhimī ananta kibā śiba sanātana |
ye premabhaktira keho nā jāne marama || 108 ||

lakhimi ananta — Lakshmi, Ananta; kiba shiva sanatana — or Shiva, Sanatana; ye prema-bhaktira — of this prema-bhakti; keho na jane marama — none knows the inner essence

108Lakshmi, Ananta, Shiva or Sanatana —
none of them knows the inner essence of this prema-bhakti.13

হেন প্রেমভক্তি প্রভু করে পরকাশ ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১০৯ ॥

hena premabhakti prabhu kare parakāśa |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 109 ||

hena prema-bhakti — such prema-bhakti; prabhu kare parakasha — the Lord reveals; ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

109Such prema-bhakti the Lord reveals —
so says with a joyful heart this Lochana Dasa.

Notes

  1. The summary covers the whole section (vv. 1–109). In the OCR of the edition it is almost illegible (lines of two columns are mixed); it has been restored from the surviving words and from the table of contents in Bhaktisiddhanta's preface (the fifth chapter of the Madhya-khanda); what is restored by sense is in square brackets. The section as a whole follows Murari Gupta (2.9–2.10).
  2. The raga is given only in the 1983 edition. The refrain is read after the 1903 edition (in the OCR of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition it is garbled); it refers to the Lord's weeping in vv. 5–12: Gora remembers His former pastimes — the pastimes of Krishna.
  3. Vishnu-maya here is the Lord's external energy, which by His will keeps the godless away from Him (cf. en/26, note 17); the Lord Himself is never subject to maya.
  4. Vv. 5–14 — cf. Murari 2.9.2–6, where the Lord sees the Boy Krishna in a dream. The request to tell no one: the Lord conceals His intimate bhava.
  5. Vv. 15–23 — cf. Murari 2.9.6–11: Nityananda sees the form of Hari with club, discus, conch, flute, bow and lotus, then the four-armed and two-armed forms. The translation of the second line of v. 20 is tentative.
  6. Vv. 24–35 — cf. Murari 2.9.13–16. Advaita lived in Shantipura, on the bank of the Ganga. Rama is Sri Rama Pandita; Narayana is an associate of the Lord in Navadvipa.
  7. Gadadhara is Radha (en/25, note 8). Narahari Sarakara is Lochana Dasa's guru, and Raghunandana his nephew, both of Shrikhanda; only Lochana Dasa mentions their presence in this scene. In Murari (2.9.17–18) Advaita sees the Lord on the seat of honour in Srivasa's shrine room.
  8. Vv. 44–55 — cf. Murari 2.9.17–22. Kaivalya and nirvana are liberation as merging into Brahman; for the devotees it is insignificant beside prema.
  9. Vv. 59–65 — cf. Murari 2.10.2–5. Haridasa Thakura is the great devotee of the holy name; the Lord Himself feeds him mahaprasada.
  10. Vv. 68–76 — cf. Murari 2.10.6–9. The kaupina is a renunciant's loincloth; the Lord gave the pieces of Nityananda's kaupina to the devotees as a holy relic.
  11. Vv. 83–101 — cf. Murari 2.10.10–13: the Lord carries Srivasa away from the circle of dancers and, seeing the devotees' alarm, appears again of Himself. Shachi's lament is only in Lochana Dasa.
  12. The devotees ascribe the Lord's return to the grace of Srivasa, whom He had taken with Him: thus the Lord's mercy comes through His devotee.
  13. Ananta (Shesha) is an expansion of the Lord; Sanatana is one of the four Kumaras (possibly also an epithet of Shiva, "the eternal Shiva"). Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 8–9: even Lakshmi did not attain the rasa of the gopis; the prema that Gaura bestowed is the highest treasure, rare even for the greatest.
